checks.name: source-only migration does not masquerade as an applied version
formal self comparison is empty and browsing creates no tasks or writes
forged context and cross-world selection rejected
real Git versions and source list rendered
new branch is real and selected
save changes forest while preserving main and applied
stale source cannot be checked as latest branch
check binds forest source and reports missing executor honestly
candidate entry reuses existing checks without applying refs
actual Git changes paginate at 32 visible files
binary addition reports actual size and absent old file
long exact text is visibly bounded and source HTML never executes
actual text diff preserves exact removed and added lines
comparison and detail reads preserve complete DB fingerprint and world
switch back reads main original source
no input focus pointer lock or page errors
full Rust restart restores branch edit

limits: No real Godot executor or model: truthful blocked check required.
Electron navigation routing is integrated separately; HTTP replaces only its transport.
Applied ref is explicitly seeded in an isolated real Git fixture; this test does not prove Godot candidate application.
